name: Horus: King's Sarcophagus
author: NakajimaAkemi
description: The four Sons of Horus, King's Sarcophagus, Walls of the Imperial Tomb and Horus the Black Flame Deity, adapted to Forbidden Memories: three Sons on the field and the Sarcophagus call the Deity, and the Tomb empowers the family. Sold as a pack on the Password screen.

cards.name: Imsety, Glory of Horus
cards.description: The eldest Son of Horus. With two brothers on the field, King's Sarcophagus opens and the Black Flame Deity rises.
cards.notes: Real card: Lv8 DARK Spellcaster 3000/1800, revives from the GY with King's Sarcophagus. Scaled for FM, where any level can be played without tributes.

cards.name: Duamutef, Blessing of Horus
cards.description: A jackal-headed Son of Horus. Weak alone, but Walls of the Imperial Tomb blesses it beyond its brothers.
cards.notes: Real card: 0/0, gains 1200 ATK/DEF per Horus monster. Here the Tomb equip gives it +2400 instead of the family's +700.

cards.name: Qebehsenuef, Protection of Horus
cards.description: The falcon-headed Son of Horus. It shields the family with its wings while the Sarcophagus is readied.
cards.notes: Real card: 2500/2000, stops the opponent targeting Horus monsters. Here the family's wall: high DEF, and the Tomb adds +1200.

cards.name: Hapi, Guidance of Horus
cards.description: The baboon-headed Son of Horus. It guides its brothers to the tomb and the Deity's return.
cards.notes: Real card: 2400/1600, recycles cards from the GY or banishment.

cards.name: Horus the Black Flame Deity
cards.description: The god-king rises from King's Sarcophagus when three of his Sons stand guard, burning the field in black flame.
cards.notes: Real card: 3000/1800, Special Summoned with King's Sarcophagus when a Horus card leaves the field. Here the ritual result.

cards.name: King's Sarcophagus
cards.description: Offer three Sons of Horus on your field to call Horus the Black Flame Deity.
cards.notes: Real card: Continuous Spell, the engine of the deck. FM has no continuous spells, so it is the ritual that brings out the Deity.

cards.name: Walls of the Imperial Tomb
cards.description: Equip only to a Horus monster. +700 ATK/DEF; Duamutef +2400, Qebehsenuef +1200, the Deity +1000.
cards.notes: Real card: Field Spell whose name becomes King's Sarcophagus. FM's six terrains cannot be added to, so it is the family's equip.

packs.name: Imperial Tomb
packs.description: The Sons of Horus, the Sarcophagus, the Tomb and the Black Flame Deity.
